subject: Reserved capacity term structure & phased start proposal — HelionGrid (RDW-9876)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@heliongrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated pool sizing & term options

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HelionGrid is very interested in moving from pilot to a dedicated GPU pool.  A few asks from our side as we prep procurement:  
- Can you provide side-by-side pricing scenarios for 12 / 24 / 36 month reserved commits for a 64-GPU pool (NVIDIA A100 class equivalence) and a 128-GPU pool?  We care about both nominal monthly charge and effective unit $/token equivalence.
- What throughput guarantees / SLOs do you commit to at each tier (p50/p95 latency or tokens/sec per GPU)? 
- We anticipate a phased ramp (we won't need full capacity Day 1). Please include recommended ramp schedules and any required start-gate conditions.

I've attached our 6-month forecast to help size the ramp. Procurement wants firm start-date options on the order of 30–60 days.  

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Ops, HelionGrid

Attachment: HelionGrid_MonthlyForecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@heliongrid.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing & term options

Hi Elena — great to hear.  Attached is a short pricing pack with three scenarios and example ramp templates. High level summary below — happy to walk through live.

Attachments: RDW-Dedicated_Pricing_Scenarios.pdf

Summary (64 GPU / baseline throughput):
- 12-month: $95k/mo; no startup credit; throughput SLO: 120k tokens/sec aggregate (p95 latency target 250ms)
- 24-month: $78k/mo (≈18% effective discount vs 12mo); includes 1-month startup credit if start within 45 days of signature
- 36-month: $66k/mo (≈30% effective discount vs 12mo); requires 60% brand-new capacity commitment in first 3 months; includes 1.5-month startup credit

128 GPU pricing scales roughly 1.85x (volume tier) with same SLO set and optional burst lanes (up to +20% capacity for short windows).

Ramp guidance (recommended conservative):
- Month 0–1: 25% capacity
- Month 2–3: 60% capacity
- Month 4–6: 100% capacity

Start windows: we can target a June 1st start if contract is signed by May 1st; later starts push the startup credit eligibility out.

Call to action: tell me which term you prefer and whether you need a tighter SLA for p99 or dedicated burst lanes — will loop in finance for final pricing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0142

Subject: Internal: HelionGrid RDW-9876 pricing posture

Quick internal note on posture before we respond with a formal counter:  
- 24mo looks like the best balance: pricing at ~$78k/mo and 1-mo credit is attractive, recommend we offer a one-time onboarding credit of 10% of first invoice to help close.
- For 36mo we can go to ~28–30% discount but require clearer ramp and earlier start (signature within 21 days) to protect utilization. Offer contingent extra 0.5-month credit if they commit to a 6-mo partial ramp (i.e., 50%+ by month 3).
- If they push for p99 SLA for <10ms on inference, we should ask for a premium; otherwise stick to p95 targets.

Asking Vivek for final sign-off on 10% onboarding credit for 24mo and the 36mo uplift.

-Aditya
Principal Sales Manager
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: HelionGrid RDW-9876 pricing posture

Finance note: if we grant a 10% onboarding credit, recommend structuring it as a one-time invoice credit applied at first billing rather than a reduction to committed ARR. That preserves our revenue recognition and simplifies accounting. Also recommend we split the invoicing into 2 tranches for a 24mo deal: 70% upfront for the first 6 months (prepaid), rest monthly to reduce churn risk. I've attached a quick invoice milestone template.

Attachment: HelionGrid_Invoice_Milestones_Template.xlsx

-Grace
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Elena Rossi <elena@heliongrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@heliongrid.com
Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing & term options

Thanks Monica — we reviewed internally and prefer the 24-month path with your proposed pricing, subject to two asks:  
1) We need a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first invoice (helps cover integration & retraining costs).
2) Confirmed phased ramp: month1 = 30%, month3 = 60%, month6 = 100%. If you can commit to a June 1 start window, procurement can sign by May 6.

We also want a clause guaranteeing access to +15% burst capacity for two 8-hour windows per week during our scale-up months (months 1–6). That is non-negotiable for our initial production cutover.

If you can get back with these mechanics and a redline-friendly agreement, we'll push to procurement.

Elena
Head of Platform Ops, HelionGrid

Elena — big thanks, this is straightforward and we can do it. Confirming negotiated details below so procurement has a single note-of-record for their SOW/PO: 

Agreed commercial term (summary):
- Term: 24 months (RDW-9876)
- Nominal monthly fee (64 GPU baseline): $78,000/month
- One-time onboarding credit: 10% of first invoice (applied as invoice credit at first billing)
- Ramp schedule (agreed): Month 1 = 30% capacity; Month 3 = 60% capacity; Month 6 = 100% capacity
- Burst lanes: +15% capacity available up to two 8-hour windows per week during months 1–6; no additional charge within those windows
- Start window: Target start June 1st; contract signature needed by May 6th to guarantee startup credit and burst reservations
- Invoice cadence: 70% of first 6 months prepaid (applied to month 1–6), remaining billed monthly thereafter (Grace to provide milestone invoice schedule)

Next steps:
1) I'll circulate an MSA + SOW with the negotiated items and an editable DocuSign link by end of day tomorrow.
2) Grace will attach the invoice milestone schedule and PO instructions.
3) Aditya / I will be available for an intake call with your procurement team this week if they need clarifications.

If that aligns, please confirm and we'll send a redline-ready contract.

Thanks — looking forward to getting HelionGrid onboarded.

Monica Patel
